title: Azure SQL vs Cosmos DB
description: Choose between Azure SQL Database and Cosmos DB for your data model and consistency needs.

data.text: You are building a product catalog that needs to support both relational queries (product details, pricing, inventory) and flexible schemas (product attributes vary by category). Global distribution is required. Should you use Azure SQL or Cosmos DB?

Use **Azure SQL** if your data is relational and you need strong consistency, JOINs, and ACID transactions. Use **Cosmos DB** if you need multi-model support (document, key-value, graph), global distribution, and flexible schemas. For the product catalog with varying attributes, **Cosmos DB for MongoDB API** is ideal.

data.title: Azure SQL - Relational Schema

data.text: Why Cosmos DB for Flexible Catalog

**Cosmos DB** supports multi-model data (document, key-value, graph, column-family) and global distribution with <10ms latency. **Azure SQL** requires fixed schemas and doesn't natively support global distribution.
